text: Implemented ridge CCA, generalized-eigen roots, held-out RRR predictive gain, CPCA block inference, multiblock consensus, and separate feature-null evidence with Bonferroni/Holm/BH. Each family has an explicit target/null/validity contract and an independent base-R fixture. Focused inference tests pass 64/64 on JVM and 64/64 on Scala.js; repository-wide compileAll and testAll pass on 2026-07-17. Shared-boundary and diff checks are clean.
